messages:
marco: short handoff from the Zephyrus-13B bring-up (fp16 / INT8 / INT6) against the GTN-combo slices. dropping everything here for product + runtime.
tess: TL;DR please.
marco: TL;DR: INT6 gives biggest cost reduction but produces concentrated regressions on long multi-turn instructions and table extraction. INT8 is the pragmatic sweet spot for beta. fp16 keeps fidelity for long docs.
li: can you paste unit econ + quality numbers? leadership wants $/1k tokens and a small score.
marco: unit econ (including batching & kvcache effects): fp16 = $1.08 / 1k tokens; INT8 = $0.53 / 1k; INT6 = $0.37 / 1k.
marco: quality (macro-F1 delta vs fp16 on GTN-combo slices): INT8 -0.5 pts; INT6 -2.3 pts. hallucination probe (n=1100): INT8 +0.5% abs, INT6 +1.7% abs.
ops-bot: smoke: PASS. quant-kernel-errors: 0. kvcache-hit-delta: INT8 -1.1%, INT6 -4.9%.
tess: latency p95?
marco: p95: fp16=225ms baseline, INT8=236ms (+11ms), INT6=290ms (+65ms)  INT6 hit extra reassembly CPU tail.
li: product wants single-number for the playbook. I created "PulseScore" = 0.6*Quality_norm + 0.25*CostSavings_norm + 0.15*InvLatency_norm. CostSavings normalized so greater savings -> higher. InvLatency = fp16_latency/variant_latency.
marco: normalized snapshot below:
```
Variant | Quality_norm | CostSavings_norm | InvLatency_norm | PulseScore
fp16    | 1.00         | 0.00             | 1.00            | 1.00
INT8    | 0.995        | 0.488            | 0.953           | 0.995*0.6 + 0.488*0.25 + 0.953*0.15 = 0.91
INT6    | 0.979        | 0.663            | 0.776           | = 0.88
```
(note: rounding)
tess: PulseScore nudges INT8. product will ask for recommended default + routing rules + a one-line blurb.
marco: recommendation: default -> INT8 for GTN beta. Exceptions -> route to fp16 when signals detect: long_context (>3.5k tokens), structured table extraction, or legal/financial slices. INT6 should be shadowed at 7% for monitoring and kept off as default until KV reassembly & kernel patches land.
li: routing example for runtime: `if (metadata.context_tokens>3500 || metadata.task=="table_extraction" || metadata.slice in ["legal","finance"]) model="fp16" elif metadata.profile=="bulk_low_risk" model="INT6" else model="INT8"`
marco: ops plan: start INT8 canary at 4% (swap default), ramp to 30% over 48h if no slice regressions. Shadow INT6 @7% to collect failing examples. Canary flag: `feature.gtn.zephyrus13b.quant_canary=0.04`. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/boards/pulse-zephyrus13b
tess: product blurb (2 lines): "Recommend INT8 for Zephyrus-13B as the default in the GTN betait balances token economics and fidelity. Route long-context, table-extraction, and legal/financial requests to fp16. INT6 remains shadow-only pending kernel fixes"
li: compact scorecard row for onboarding playbook: [Variant, CostPer1k, DeltaF1, p95_ms] -> INT8, $0.53, -0.5pt, +11ms; INT6, $0.37, -2.3pt, +65ms; fp16, $1.08, 0pt, baseline.
marco: follow-ups: 1) PR to gtn/docs with blurb + scorecard (tess) 2) runtime ticket for INT6 KV reassembly (assign runtime team) 3) schedule 48h canary check (ops-bot).
tess: will open PR after product sign-off. thanks team. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: scheduled re-eval job at 3629999999 to re-run after any kernel pushes.
